worldcombat.skill.doodle.summary: Copy one sample’s Ability to yourself and nearby allies; the sample may be a foe or a companion. Against non-Pokémon, depict its strongest combat characteristic.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.use.0: Copy one strong Ability onto the whole team
worldcombat.skill.doodle.use.1: Unify the team's Abilities from a companion or foe before a fight
worldcombat.skill.doodle.use.2: Build the team around a target with a key Ability
worldcombat.skill.doodle.description.0: Select a sample (foe or companion) within %1$s blocks; preparation takes %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.description.1: Copy to visible, modifiable allies with a different trait within %1$s blocks, up to %2$s recipients including yourself, for %3$s. Each additional planned recipient adds 0.1 seconds of preparation. Stamp only successful installations. AI acts on known liabilities or numerical native upgrades; other Ability choices remain manual.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.timing: Range %1$s blocks, %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.growth.0: At level %1$s, base cooldown from commitment becomes %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.growth.1: At level %1$s, base cooldown from commitment becomes %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.preference.canv: A larger canvas reaches more distant allies and affects base cooldown. Each additional planned recipient adds 0.1 seconds of preparation; blocked or identical recipients do not use a slot.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.preference.ai.m: The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means sketching from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.preference.ai.l: On: a holding companion will leave its post to sketch the target. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
worldcombat.skill.doodle.world: When depicting a non-Pokémon, copy its strongest attack, movement or defensive characteristic to yourself and allies within %2$s blocks, up to %3$s recipients total, for %1$s. Each copy ends on expiry or cleansing; later equipment and effects still apply.
